lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. You’re carrying too much right now, and this is an emergency for both of you. Please call nine one one now, or ask someone right there to call nine one one for you. While you do that, Place your baby on their back in a flat, empty sleep space, not the car seat. Stay with another adult if you can. I can stay on the line with you.
originalTexts: Thank you for telling me. You’re carrying too much right now, and this is an emergency for both of you. Please call 911 now, or ask someone right there to call 911 for you. slottedCanonicalQueryTemplates: No, not the baby, I put him in the car seat to sleep because I’m so exhausted and I know that’s not safe, I just don’t know what to do.
